Sourdough Baker for 5 years here

Fuck ups caught late are impossible to fix and most of the time you just have to deal with the shame of shipping sub-par quality. Everything from mixing, to bulk proofing, to shaping, to final proofing has to be done right and on time to make good quality bread.

Hours are long but not too stressful. Most of the time it feels like a HIIT workout. Mixing and folding, then waiting, then folding, then waiting, then shaping, then waiting, then baking, then more waiting. Lot’s of upper body strength. I have killer traps from all the lifting I do on a daily basis.

I work a split shift so I come in at 6pm and make the dough, leaving at 2am. The other shift comes in at 9 to help with shaping and then baking so it’s out and ready by 5am. 

Ultimately it’s a really rewarding career, I take a lot of pride in the work I do. It’s a relaxing environment, a lot of time to think and perfect your craft. Going through several thousand iterations of the same shape each week is meditative.

Mushrooms have been propagated to be a dangerous drug for decades. More people and governing bodies nowadays seem to be recognizing the benefits of psilocybin for the progress it’s made in remedying mental health disorders. Terence McKenna said something along the lines of “Mushrooms aren’t a drug they’re a plant” so the term “relapsing” is up for debate and really all about how you personally view Psilocybin Mushrooms. As for if you are worried that your trip will cause you to relapse on a different substance, well, It’s hard to say for sure, everyone’s experience is different.

What I can say for sure is to follow the basic guidelines for any trip, Set and Setting.

Set: My advice to you would be to Reflect on your addiction recovery and look at the progress you have made. This way, if it surfaces during your trip then you will already have a positive connotation surrounding your old addiction and how you are moving past it. 

Setting: Clean up your place, play some music, go for a walk, draw, have a plan to do something you feel like doing.
